caution_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
caution_supplements.mechanism: Theoretical enzyme induction may theoretically affect naloxone metabolism, though clinical significance is minimal due to naloxone's short half-life and rapid clearance
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced naloxone efficacy in emergency settings; no routine dose adjustment needed

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay absorption of oral naloxone formulations by slowing gastrointestinal transit
caution_foods.action: Take oral naloxone with or without food; parenteral and intranasal routes are unaffected

monitoring_notes: Naloxone has minimal drug interactions due to its short half-life (30-81 minutes), low systemic bioavailability, and rapid hepatic metabolism. Primary monitoring should focus on opioid withdrawal symptoms and adequacy of opioid reversal rather than supplement/food interactions.
